agency: City of El Cajon Community Development, Building Safety (Building Division)

code_edition.value: 2025 California Electrical Code (adopted by reference in Title 15 of the El Cajon Municipal Code)
code_edition.quote: California Electrical Code, 2025 Edition—Adopted by reference. The California Electrical Code, 2025 Edition, as published by the International Code Council

requirements.item: Online service request application with current and proposed panel size and additional loads
requirements.quote: For electric service, current and proposed panel size and additional loads.

requirements.item: Express Program available for residential service upgrades up to 400A with no added load and 3'x3' workspace
requirements.quote: Project Size: Residential projects (up to 400Amps) & Commercial projects (up to 200Amps) Location: Panel location must meet all Clearances & Standards. - There must be an existing 3' x 3' clear and level workspace in front of the meter panel.

requirements.item: Solar and battery interconnection application via DIIS Online Application Portal with Electrical One-Line Diagram
requirements.quote: Applications can be submitted and tracked through the DIIS Online Application Portal.

requirements.item: SDG&E Permission to Operate (PTO) required after generating facilities are installed and tested
requirements.quote: Permission to Operate (PTO) – when all facilities are installed, tested, and declared ready for service, SDG&E will issue the customer a PTO.

open_questions: El Cajon's Building Permits, Photovoltaic Permits, and Forms subpages linked from https://www.elcajon.gov/your-government/departments/community-development/building-fire-safety-division (including https://www.elcajon.gov/your-government/departments/community-development/building-fire-safety/photovoltaic) were not indexed or accessible to extract verbatim job-specific submittal checklists or over-the-counter eligibility rules.

The PDFs listed in Building Division Document Central—including 'Residential EV Charging Checklist' (https://www.elcajon.gov/discover-el-cajon/advanced-components/custom-documents-images-calendar/-item-2878/-toggle-all/-sortn-EDate/-folder-39/-npage-3), 'Owner Builder Form', 'Permit Application', and 'Photovoltaic - Fire Code Installation standards' (https://www.elcajon.gov/discover-el-cajon/advanced-components/custom-documents-images-calendar/-item-526/-sortn-EDate/-toggle-all/-folder-39/-sortd-asc/-npage-2)—could not be opened directly to verify their contents, revision dates, or load calculation requirements.

The exact effective date of the 2025 California Electrical Code adoption ordinance in the October 14, 2025 City Council agenda (https://public.destinyhosted.com/elcajdocs/2025/CC/20251014_271/270_10-14-25%20agenda%20full%20-%203PM.pdf) could not be verified verbatim from the indexed excerpt.
No City of El Cajon-published residential electrical load calculation worksheet, mandatory NEC 220 method, EV charger service load factor, or plan sheet size standard was found on elcajon.gov.
